metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over every Maven release
note: Leads are not verified parsers. Ranks are assigned only among verified paths.

leads.name: org.jooq:jooq
leads.reason: jOOQ Parser (DSL.using(dialect).parser().parseQuery) returns a Query object model traversable through the QOM $-API; documented in the jOOQ manual.

leads.name: org.apache.spark:spark-sql_2.12
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead, not run. spark-sql is Spark's whole SQL engine (SparkSession, DataFrames, execution); its parser entry point SparkSqlParser (internal org.apache.spark.sql.execution package) extends the selected spark-catalyst AstBuilder with command rules and would parse both controls through the same grammar and AstBuilder, so it would be a same-family wrapper with no own differential for these controls. Its metric counts engine users, not parser users. Accepting it under the wrapper rule would displace the tenth path; left for a user decision.

leads.name: com.alibaba:druid
leads.reason: Druid's SQL module: SQLUtils.parseStatements(sql, DbType) returns SQLStatement ASTs (SQLSelectStatement, SQLInsertStatement). The artifact also contains a JDBC connection pool.

leads.name: com.facebook.presto:presto-parser
leads.reason: Presto SqlParser.createStatement returns an AST Statement (Query, Insert).

leads.name: org.apache.calcite:calcite-core
leads.reason: Calcite SqlParser.create(sql).parseStmt returns SqlNode trees.

leads.name: org.apache.hive:hive-exec
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead. ParseDriver.parse(command) returns a ParseResult whose getTree() is the HiveQL ASTNode tree (TOK_QUERY, TOK_FROM, TOK_JOIN, TOK_INSERT_INTO, ...); documented in the Hive 4.2.1 Javadocs. The parser classes ship in the hive-exec uber jar.

leads.name: com.github.jsqlparser:jsqlparser
leads.reason: CCJSqlParserUtil.parse returns Statement objects (Select/PlainSelect, Insert).

leads.name: org.apache.spark:spark-catalyst_2.12
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead: Scala 2.12 coordinate of spark-catalyst. CatalystSqlParser.parsePlan returns the unresolved LogicalPlan built by AstBuilder before analysis, which is the parser's syntax tree.

leads.name: io.trino:trino-parser
leads.reason: Trino SqlParser.createStatement; same ANTLR lineage as presto-parser.

leads.name: io.prestosql:presto-parser
leads.reason: Predecessor name of the selected io.trino:trino-parser: PrestoSQL was renamed Trino, io.prestosql:presto-parser ends at release 350 and io.trino:trino-parser starts at 351 (Maven Central metadata). Excluded as a predecessor rename (trust-dns-proto / zend-json precedent); its metric is not added to Trino's.

leads.name: org.apache.spark:spark-catalyst_2.13
leads.reason: Scala 2.13 build of the same spark-catalyst sources as the selected org.apache.spark:spark-catalyst_2.12 coordinate (529). Not a separate parser; the two coordinates' metrics are not combined.

leads.name: org.apache.flink:flink-sql-parser
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead. Flink generates its own JavaCC parser from Calcite's Parser.jj template plus Flink extensions; with SqlParser.config().withParserFactory(FlinkSqlParserImpl.FACTORY) it returns Calcite SqlNode trees and Flink subclasses. 261 of its 381 grammar productions share names with calcite-core 1.42's 268; 120 are Flink-only.

leads.name: org.apache.shardingsphere:shardingsphere-sql-parser-engine
leads.reason: ShardingSphere SQL parser engine (ANTLR per dialect).

leads.name: org.apache.spark:spark-sql-api_2.13
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead. Spark module that holds the ANTLR-generated SqlBaseLexer/SqlBaseParser and data-type parsing, but not the statement AstBuilder (CatalystSqlParser is in spark-catalyst). Covered by the selected spark-catalyst path; shared family.

leads.name: com.github.vertical-blank:sql-formatter
leads.reason: Formatter that returns text; no syntax tree.

leads.name: org.apache.shardingsphere:shardingsphere-parser-sql-engine
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead. 5.4+ name of the selected shardingsphere-sql-parser-engine; in 5.5.3 it is a pom aggregator (modules core and dialect) with no classes. Same project as the selected pre-rename coordinate; not added.

leads.name: com.google.zetasql:zetasql-client
leads.documented_api_lead: Parser/Analyzer via the local ZetaSQL service
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead, not run. The Java client delegates parsing and analysis to the native C++ ZetaSQL library through a local service, so Java line coverage would not reach the parser; needs native coverage. Below the ten-path ceiling.

leads.name: org.apache.shardingsphere:shardingsphere-sql-parser-mysql
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead. MySQL dialect module loaded through SPI by the selected shardingsphere-sql-parser-engine path (pinned as its dependency); not a separate parser path.

leads.name: org.apache.calcite:calcite-babel
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead, not run. Calcite's Babel parser is a separately generated parser from the same template as calcite-core (shared family). Below the ten-path ceiling.

leads.name: org.apache.shardingsphere:shardingsphere-parser-sql-engine-core
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead. Renamed successor of the selected shardingsphere-sql-parser-engine (same SQLParserEngine API); not a separate parser path.

leads.name: org.apache.shardingsphere:shardingsphere-parser-sql-engine-mysql
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead. Renamed successor of the MySQL dialect module used by the selected path; a dialect plug-in, not a separate parser path.

leads.name: net.sf.jsqlparser:jsqlparser
leads.reason: Ancient JSqlParser coordinate (0.7.0); superseded by com.github.jsqlparser:jsqlparser.

leads.name: org.apache.hive:hive-parser
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead. The Hive module whose parser classes ship inside the selected hive-exec uber jar; 0 direct dependents. Its sources jar supplies the selected path's coverage sources.

leads.name: io.github.melin.superior:superior-sql-parser
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead (Maven search hit). Zero deps.dev direct dependents; not added.

leads.name: com.alibaba:fastsql
leads.metric_error: deps.dev has no MAVEN package com.alibaba:fastsql (HTTP 404)
leads.reason: Round-2 extension lead. Druid's SQL parser published separately; no metric in the snapshot source, so it stays unranked.
